_comment: Local genre data applied on top of the sources. 'categories' gives a raw catver-style category (e.g. 'Shooter / Flying Vertical') for sets no source classifies, such as games newer than the catver copies on GitHub; it is remapped through genre_map.json like catver's own entries and wins over every source. 'sets' forces a final common genre (set name -> genre), applied after the map; a parent's entry cascades to its clones. tools/reconcile_shmups.py --write-overrides can fill 'sets'; it is not run by the build.
